data_sources.V-Dem v16 (vdeminstitute/vdemdata on Git: civil liberties, regimes, fiscal source, life expectancy, schooling, child mortality, Haber-Menaldo resource income, federalism, foreign movement
data_sources.Penn World Table 10.0 (OWID mirror on Gi: GDP per capita, growth, labour share, trade openness, government consumption
data_sources.OWID energy-data (GitHub): oil and gas production per capita

blocked_sources: ourworldindata.org grapher, api.worldbank.org, v-dem.net, freedomhouse.org, wid.world, rug.nl (Maddison/PWT), dataverse.harvard.edu, zenodo.org, OECD, ILOSTAT: all refused by the container's egress proxy (HTTP 403 on CONNECT / no connection). World Bank resource-rent and tax-revenue series (NY.GDP.TOTL.RT.ZS, GC.TAX.TOTL.GD.ZS) therefore NOT used; proxies used instead.

predictors.lres_share: log(1 + resource income as % of GDP), Haber-Menaldo resource income / PWT GDP pc, 1960-2006
predictors.taxcap: V-Dem v2stfisccap: how the state funds itself (low = from state-owned assets/resources, high = income/property taxes), expert-coded
predictors.lhydro: log(1 + oil+gas production kWh per person), OWID energy data, 1965-2019 (robustness)
predictors.tax_gdp: OECD Global Revenue Statistics total tax % GDP, 1990-2016, ~80 countries (robustness)

B.design: Anchor years t = 1970,1975,...,2015. Predictor: average annual growth of real GDP per capita (PWT, national-accounts) over the 10 years BEFORE t. Outcome: change over the 10 years AFTER t. Controls: log income at t and outcome level at t; period fixed effects; SEs clustered by country.

predictors.foreign_move: V-Dem freedom of foreign movement / emigration (v2clfmove); part of the civil-liberties index, so tested only against physical integrity
predictors.gov_cons: government consumption % GDP (PWT) - a crude 'state crowds out private' measure

C.note: Outcome 'clphy' (freedom from political killing and torture) is used for the exit variable to avoid mechanical overlap.

D.missing: Union density: no reachable source (OECD/AIAS ICTWSS, ILOSTAT and OWID grapher hosts were blocked by the container's network policy; no GitHub mirror found).
